message.content:
Need to fetch the contents of the Wikipedia pages for Moon and Eliud Kipchoge to get exact numbers for Moon's minimum perigee and Kipchoge's record marathon time/pace.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch(url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon")
kipchoge_page = await web_fetch(url="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge")
print(f"Moon length: {len(moon_page)}, Kipchoge length: {len(kipchoge_page)}")
```
